goal: Rust-own the page-bounded read-only registration attempt and explicit caller-map device-copy fallback behind the public cached model-range ABI without claiming pageable HMM, fd-backed staging, remaining graph compute, or route promotion.

semantics: current C page-aligns a requested immutable host range, attempts read-only mapped host registration, and caches its adjusted device pointer on success
current C falls back to device allocation and host-to-device copy after registration is rejected
current C disables repeated range registration attempts after selected registration errors; this cross-range optimization remains pending in Rust

implementation.range_path: with_cached_abi_model_range retains either a ReadOnlyRegisteredHostMemory guard with an adjusted requested device pointer or a DeviceCopy fallback buffer
implementation.raw_mapping_boundary: abi_registered_source only forms a page-rounded borrowed source slice when it is wholly inside the caller-declared model mapping
implementation.linked_compute_consumer: ds4_gpu_rms_norm_weight_tensor consumes a page-bounded public cache request from a C-linked Rust static-library consumer
implementation.remaining_residency_policy_boundary: pageable HMM/prefetch, fd-backed direct-I/O staging, cross-range registration-disable policy, environment-selected preload/copy policy, and q8/f16 cache hooks remain pending

b300_execution.staticlib_build_command: cargo build --locked --release --features cuda-oxide-kernels -p ds4-cuda --lib with rustc-codegen-cuda

integration_risks: B300 rejects the read-only registered-host operation with CUDA error code 801, so the public path is validated there through its required device-copy fallback rather than successful zero-copy execution
Rust does not yet preserve current C cross-range registration-disable policy after an unsupported registration error
pageable HMM/prefetch and fd-backed direct-I/O staging remain outside this public ABI leaf
production still compiles ds4_cuda.cu, and static-library consumers still require whole-archive retention before route promotion
next_required_stage: M14.6b2b2b2b2b2 Pageable HMM And Fd-Backed Model-Control Policy
